snippet.title: Cozy Paintings - Official Release Teaser
snippet.description:
Hi everyone!

I'm creating my first Steam game, a cozy game about art and cats. It's called Cozy Paintings and the pitch is simple: every painting has been scrambled! Drag colors across your canvas and optimize your moves to restore famous artworks. Experiment with color palettes, unlock playful cats with strangely familiar names and watch them wander around while you paint!

The game will be released on March 9th, and a demo will be available next week!

Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4286260/Cozy_Paintings/
